verdict.rationale: Wise states directly that its card lets you 'pay and withdraw cash worldwide without any hidden fees or markups' (wise-docs-10). Its docs also cover issuing debit cards worldwide and ATM spending controls (wise-docs-4, wise-docs-30), which together support spending and cash withdrawal abroad on a card. Missing for 10: a documented fee schedule (e.g. free ATM withdrawal limits and conversion fees), explicit confirmation that this applies to Wise Business company cards, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the no-hidden-fee claim.
